verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.attio.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an index linking to Markdown versions of the doc pages, which is exactly what an agent needs. Agent-oriented material goes further: SDK apps are bootstrapped with AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, the SDK is described as designed for AI-assisted development, and a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 document is published. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant or a first-party page explaining how to point agents at the docs.
